description: Install wolproxy with addon-oauth2-proxy + addon-ssl. Verifies that oauth2-proxy starts in HTTPS mode (because addon-ssl ships internal-CA certs), listens on bearer_listen_port (8443), validates against the Zitadel-registered wolproxy-api audience, and locks the upstream wolproxy port (5000) to loopback via iptables. zitadel/default is a dependency so the addon's pre_start registers the Bearer-API audience in Zitadel. wolproxy has no UI of its own (only /wake, /status, /health) — addon-oidc is intentionally not part of this stack.
